command.goblinforest.info: Goblin Forest %s – 1v1 lane strategy with goblin clans.
command.goblinforest.help.hint: Use /gf help for all commands. Quick start: both run /gf join, then /gf start.
command.goblinforest.help.join: /gf join [red|green] – sign up for the next match, optionally choosing a clan
command.goblinforest.help.start: /gf start – start a match with everyone signed up (at least one player per clan)
command.goblinforest.help.practice: /gf start practice – practice match, also alone against an empty clan
command.goblinforest.help.stop: /gf stop – abort the running match (participants or operators)
command.goblinforest.help.reset: /gf reset – emergency: abort everything and bring all players back (operators)
command.goblinforest.help.controls: In a match: right-click hotbar items to cast spells and abilities, left-click a tower or fortress to attack it.
command.goblinforest.help.keys: Keys: B war menu, Z/X/C/V recruit, H stance, N rally point, R bloodlust, G battle slam, J fireball, K mushrooms (rebindable in controls).
command.goblinforest.joined: %s signed up for the next match (%s). Signed up: %s
command.goblinforest.match_running: A match is already running. Use /gf status to see the score.
command.goblinforest.need_both_teams: A real match needs a chieftain on each clan. To practice alone: /gf start practice
command.goblinforest.no_arena: The arena dimension is missing. Is the mod installed on the server too?
command.goblinforest.not_in_match: You are not playing in a match.
command.goblinforest.started: The match begins! You lead the %s.
command.goblinforest.starting: Starting a match with %s players, building the arena …
command.goblinforest.status.idle: No match and nobody signed up. Use /gf join to sign up.
command.goblinforest.status.lobby: Signed up for the next match: %s
command.goblinforest.status.team: %s (%s): fortress %s/%s, %s goblins, %s gold, reputation %s, chieftain level %s
command.goblinforest.stop_denied: Only participants or operators can abort the match.
item.goblinforest.kit.axe.desc: Left-click: attack enemies and enemy buildings
item.goblinforest.kit.fireball.desc: Right-click: fireball at the target, area damage
item.goblinforest.kit.healing.desc: Right-click: heals your goblins and chieftains in the area
item.goblinforest.kit.battleSlam.desc: Right-click: shockwave, damage and knockback around you
item.goblinforest.kit.rally.desc: Right-click: set a rally point, your army holds there
item.goblinforest.kit.menu.desc: Right-click (or B): recruit, upgrade, improve spells
message.goblinforest.controls: B opens the war menu. Z/X/C/V recruit, H switches stance. Destroy the enemy fortress!
message.goblinforest.forfeit_warning: The %s is no longer online. Without a return within %s seconds the match is lost.
message.goblinforest.hero_killed: Chieftain %s has fallen! %s gold for the %s.
message.goblinforest.match_error: The match was aborted due to an error. All items have been returned.
message.goblinforest.restored: Your inventory and position from before the match have been restored.
message.goblinforest.server_stopping: The server is shutting down, the match ends.
message.goblinforest.tower_destroyed: The tower of the %s has fallen! The %s gains +%s reputation.
message.goblinforest.purchase.population: No room left – upgrade your huts
message.goblinforest.purchase.unit_cap: Too many goblins on the field
stats.goblinforest.units: Goblins: %s recruited, %s enemies killed, %s lost, best soldier level %s
stats.goblinforest.economy: Gold: %s earned, %s spent, reputation %s, %s building damage
menu.goblinforest.title: War menu
menu.goblinforest.unit.warrior.desc: Tough, blocks frontal hits with a shield
menu.goblinforest.unit.assassin.desc: Stealthed, double first strike, hunts chieftains
menu.goblinforest.stance.advance.desc: The army marches down the lane to the enemy fortress.
menu.goblinforest.stance.hold.desc: The army stops and defends (or at the war horn's rally point).
menu.goblinforest.stance.retreat.desc: The army falls back to the fortress and heals there.
menu.goblinforest.upgrades.hint: Upgrades apply to all goblins of that type, including future ones.
menu.goblinforest.upgrade.walls.desc: More health for fortress and tower
menu.goblinforest.ability.battleSlam.des: Free: shockwave with damage and knockback
